# Third-party notices

Koalino is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version; see `LICENSE`. It is built on the components below, each under its own license. Every license listed is compatible with GPLv3. Where a component offers a choice (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`), Koalino uses it under any of the options.

## AI models

| Model | From | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Whisper (ggml conversions by whisper.cpp) | OpenAI; ggerganov/whisper.cpp | MIT |
| pyannote segmentation-3.0 (`segmentation.onnx`) | pyannote | MIT |
| SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb (`embedding.onnx`) | SpeechBrain | Apache-2.0 |
